vfx_fly_wind.png.prompt:
The attached reference image is an existing icon from this game - copy its art style exactly: thick black outlines, flat colours with soft simple shading, clean cute cartoon look, not photorealistic, no gradients or glow effects.

Draw a small CARTOON WHIRLWIND / TORNADO seen from the side, standing upright on nothing. Classic funnel shape: WIDE and open at the TOP, tapering down to a NARROW point at the BOTTOM. Made of two or three curling ribbons of wind that spiral around the funnel, with a few short curved speed-lines and two or three tiny swirling leaves or dust specks caught in it near the base.
Colours: soft pale blue-white wind ribbons (the same off-white and pale blue as the wings in the reference), with the same thick black outline weight.

This sits UNDER a flying monster to show it is hovering, so: it must read clearly at about 100 pixels wide, the funnel must be centred horizontally, and the picture must be WIDER THAN TALL (a low, squat whirlwind - not a tall thin tornado).
Nothing else in the picture: no ground, no shadow, no creature, no scenery, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
Draw everything SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour. Nothing transparent or see-through.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green in the whirlwind.
Output 512x384 PNG. Save the image as vfx_fly_wind.png in the current directory and report the path.
